description: Hand-written traveler descriptions for the LLM spike (python -m ai.benchmark). Each `expect` lists what a correct profile must show. Checks: high = interest >= 0.7, low = interest <= 0.3, pace relaxed <= 0.4 / packed >= 0.6, dietary = each term appears in an entry (no `dietary` = the profile must list no diet, which catches invented ones), accessibility = at least one entry, avoid = each category listed, budget_total within 5%, currency exact, max_walk_at_most / at_least in minutes, day_start_at_or_after / at_or_before and day_end_at_or_before as HH:MM.

descriptions.text: We're two vegetarians going mainly to eat. Markets, bakeries, long lunches. We hate rushing, so a couple of things a day is plenty. Budget is around 900 euros.
I'm a retired history teacher. I want castles, monasteries and old ruins, as many as I can fit in each day. Not interested in bars or shopping at all.
Museums and galleries are the whole point of the trip for me, modern art especially. I don't care much for parks or nature.
Bachelor party weekend! Bars, clubs, nightlife until late. Nobody is getting up before noon.
My wife uses a wheelchair, so we need step-free routes and very short distances between stops. We both love architecture and old churches.
Student backpacker with 300 dollars for the whole trip. I walk everywhere and don't mind 40 minute walks. Into nature and cheap street food.
Family with two young kids, 4 and 7. Parks, the zoo, ice cream. We need to be back at the hotel by 7pm and the kids can't do long walks.
Honestly I'm going for the shopping. Malls, boutiques, souvenirs. Maybe one museum if it rains.
Coeliac traveler, so strictly gluten-free. I love cafes and slow mornings and usually start my day around 10:30.
Architecture photographer. I want to see buildings, bridges and viewpoints from early morning, around 7am, until sunset. Pack as much in as possible.
We eat halal only. We're interested in history and old religious buildings, at a moderate pace. Budget 1500 pounds.
Please no churches or museums, I've seen enough of them. I want parks, beaches and good seafood.
food. lots of food.
Just want a nice relaxing break somewhere.
Anniversary trip with a budget of 5000 euros. Fine dining, wine bars and a bit of art. Relaxed pace, nothing before 10am.
Viajo con mi pareja. Nos encanta la historia y la arquitectura, y no nos gusta salir de noche. Tenemos un presupuesto de 1000 euros.
I'm 78 and walk slowly with a cane, ten minutes of walking at a time at most. I enjoy gardens and quiet museums, and I like to be back by 6pm.
Vegan. I love techno clubs and late nights, so sleeping in is mandatory. Also really into street art.
Hiking and nature all day, I happily walk for hours. Severe nut allergy. Not interested in shopping.
My budget is 150,000 yen. I like a bit of everything: food, history and art, at a balanced pace.
